Only applicable to semantic-embeddings strategy.

ast_context.description: Include TreeSitter-derived AST metadata in the semantic prompt (semantic-embeddings only, requires chunking.code_aware for best results)

results.description: Result post-processing configuration (fusion, deduplication, limiting). If omitted, sensible defaults are applied in code.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (top K)

fusion.description: Configuration for combining results from multiple strategies. If omitted and multiple strategies are configured, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (rrf) with k=60 is used.

k.description: RRF smoothing parameter k (only for RRF strategy)

weights.description: Strategy weights for weighted fusion (strategy name -> weight)

reranking.description: Configuration for reranking results using a specialized reranking model. Reranking re-scores the retrieved results to improve relevance accuracy.

model.description: Model reference for reranking (can be inline like 'dmr/model-name' or a reference to a defined model)

top_k.description: Optional: only rerank top K results for efficiency. When unset or 0, defaults to the global results.limit (which itself defaults to 15).

threshold.description: Optional: minimum score threshold after reranking (filter results below this score)

criteria.description: Optional: domain-specific relevance criteria to guide scoring. This text is appended to the base reranking prompt to customize what 'relevance' means for your use case. Supported by OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini providers (not DMR native reranking).
examples: Prioritize recent information and practical examples over historical context
When scoring relevance, focus on code examples and implementation details

return_full_content.description: Return full document content instead of just the matched chunk. The full document is read directly from the file system.

RemoteOAuthConfig.description: OAuth configuration for remote MCP servers. Set clientId for servers that do not support Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591); other fields tune the flow and also apply when the client is registered dynamically

clientId.description: OAuth client ID. When omitted, docker-agent uses Dynamic Client Registration or prompts interactively

callbackPort.description: Fixed port for the OAuth callback server (default: random available port)

callbackRedirectURL.description: Optional OAuth redirect URI used in place of http://127.0.0.1:{callbackPort}/callback. The literal placeholder ${callbackPort} is replaced with the actual local callback port at runtime. The external URL is expected to redirect the browser back to the local callback server.

provider.description: Evaluator backend (typesafe or openai Decisions), or a named provider.

base_url.description: API base URL. TypeSafe defaults to https://api.typesafe.ai with /v1/systemone; OpenAI defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1 with /decisions.

endpoint.description: Exact HTTP(S) evaluator URL, overriding base_url and its default path. No credentials, query, or fragment.

token_key.description: API key environment variable for direct calls (TYPESAFE_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY).

bypass_models_gateway.description: Connect directly even when a models gateway is configured. Custom base_url and endpoint do not implicitly bypass the gateway.

cost.description: Explicit USD pricing per one million evaluator input/output tokens. Overrides built-in evaluator pricing, including on custom endpoints. An empty object declares free evaluations; cache rates are unused.

decisions.description: Choice keys (or true/false for booleans) mapped to guard decisions.

min_probability.description: Minimum selected-outcome probability to apply its mapping; not the confidence metric.

fallback.description: Decision for uncertainty or unmapped outcomes; provider failures always block.

AgentRouting.description: Local agents that this agent's before_agent_run and after_agent_complete hooks may route to. Requires at least one of those hooks; the agent cannot route to itself or to harness agents, and the combined graph of possible routes and force_handoff edges must not contain a cycle.

allowed_agents.description: Names of agents defined in this config that a hook may select. A transition to any other agent fails the run.

default_agent.description: Agent used when a choice-evaluator assessment is uncertain (low probability, tie, invalid distribution) or the evaluator fails. Required when an evaluator selects the route; must be in allowed_agents. Cancellation and budget exhaustion never use it.

RoutingPolicy.description: Maps a choice evaluator's outcomes to agents. Kept apart from the evaluator so the same assessment can drive different actions.

routes.description: Every evaluator choice mapped to an agent in routing.allowed_agents. Missing or unknown choices are configuration errors.

min_probability.description: Minimum selected-choice probability required to use its route. Enforced by the runtime, not the evaluator prompt; calibrate on representative requests.
